value.title: -Witchling- Part 2
value.synopsis: The witchlings address an unfolding disaster at City Hall, but Sekai foresees a greater disaster to come.

value.title: Song of Purification
value.synopsis: As the RD struggles to keep the outbreak under control, Sekai rushes to save the people of her old church.

value.title: Fragment
value.synopsis: The witchlings debate the fallout from their last mission while the RD Chief struggles to understand.

value.title: Malice
value.synopsis: The witchlings are left reeling from a sudden betrayal as disappearances rise around the city.

value.title: Familiar
value.synopsis: The witchlings are forced to run from suspicious townspeople while trying to find and stop Kugel.

value.title: Memory Egg
value.synopsis: Exploring Kugel's memories forces the witchlings to confront a shocking truth about their world.

value.title: Phenomenon
value.synopsis: As time ticks down for Kamitsubaki CIty, Kafu confronts the forces preventing her from singing.

value.title: Blackout
value.synopsis: Maxwell prepares to unleash hell on Kamitsubaki City, but the witchlings are far from a united front.

value.title: Desire
value.synopsis: The situation grows even more dire for the witchlings as Maxwell's plan comes to fruition.

value.title: Virtual Real
value.synopsis: Kafu finds herself in a strange situation following her last, desperate song.

value.title: Regenerate
value.synopsis: The girls return to Kamitsubaki City for their final confrontation with Maxwell.

value.title: Kamitsubaki City Under Construction
value.synopsis: The witchlings begin rebuilding Kamitsubaki City, but something is missing.
